title: SalesStoreCatalog - Data API
description: Represents the catalog associated with a store. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The default value is USD. Possible values are: USD—U.S. Dollar

ImplementorType.description: The type of implementor. WebStoreCatalog is the only available implementor type for SalesStoreCatalog.

ProductCatalogId.description: The ID that references the product catalog.

SalesStoreId.description: The ID that references the store.

special_access_rules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access a store.
